I can do that — before I cancel anything I need to confirm a few details so I don’t remove the wrong event.

1) Is the event title exactly "Design review meeting" (or is it named something slightly different)?  
2) Do you want me to cancel the entire recurring series (every Tuesday afternoon going forward) or just upcoming occurrences (or a single date)?  
3) Should attendees be notified of the cancellation, or do you want the event removed only from your calendar?  
4) Any other restrictions (start date to cancel from, or keep past meetings)?

Reply with answers (or just “yes — cancel the series and notify attendees” if that matches), and I’ll proceed.
